faqs.q: Sec. 42-79. - I.F.C. Section 1103.2, Emergency responder radio coverage in existing buildings.
faqs.a:
Section 1103.2. Emergency responder radio coverage in existing buildings,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
1103.2. IFC Section 1103.2. Emergency responder radio coverage in existing buildings.
Buildings undergoing alterations in accordance with Section 505 of the International
                  Existing Building Code (Alteration - Level 3), and Section 507 of the International
                  Existing Building Code (Additions), shall comply with the Emergency Responder Radio
                  Coverage provisions in Section 510 of the IFC."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
